title: 오늘은 안 웃어
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie, Dream Pop. A clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, jazzy chord progression with light chorus and reverb. A warm, melodic electric bass follows the root notes with occasional melodic fills. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a soft kick drum playing a steady backbeat. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, breathy tenor with light doubling. The arrangement features subtle Rhodes piano chords and a clean electric guitar lead with a slight overdrive. Key of E Major, 85 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar chords with chorus, melodic bass]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
해가 묶이기 전에 괜찮아 너와
습관처럼 웃어 입꼬리가 올라
파스텔 차야 창에 비친 얼굴
가로등이 번져
누구인지 몰라
매일 그를 봐 지치는 줄 몰라

[Chorus]
괜찮다 먼저야 물어보기 전에
거울 속 표정 [electric guitar lead enters]
